gate.durability: Only in-memory scheduling changes. A completed seal or unchanged eligibility decision is cached for the captured inode epoch. Every mutation invalidates the cached decision; cancellation and errors never mark an inode checked. Catalog commits, inode syncs, publication and retirement ordering are unchanged.
gate.tests: Repeated read-only opens of both freshly sealed and previously sealed files schedule no new candidates; writing revokes the decision and the updated bytes reseal and pass integrity checks. A successful seal absorbs a read-only close queued during preparation. Existing concurrent mutation cancellation, open-reader retirement, crash/recovery and mounted Cargo suites pass.

limitations: Two reversed-order rounds on a shared node, not a statistical significance claim.
Warm OS caches; debug incremental only.
CPU idle observation does not prove background sealing drained.
Cumulative phase times overlap; they are not added Cargo latency.
Two workers in both SL7 cases; fixed source/profile/output paths; the candidate caches unchanged seal decisions.
